in_sanskrit.name: Barman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Son of the God of Drinking
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Barman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Barman is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bharmana', which means 'Son of Bharmana'. Bharmana is a name of the God Indra, who is often associated with drinking and feasting. Therefore, the name Barman symbolizes the son of a god who is a provider of joy and abundance.
